meta.title: MQCS to SAP PO Integration: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and repeat as a Buyer on the same tenant
Verify or configure the tenant's Enterprise plan requirement
Locate and execute the MQCS-to-SAP PO Integration transfer of the final Master QCS
Assert that the SAP transfer action is refused or absent for the non-Buyer
Assert that the SAP transfer action is available to the Buyer
Compare role-specific behavior while preserving the same tenant and event
